description.correction: ThreatFox is a community platform from abuse.ch and Spamhaus for sharing and querying malware-related IOCs. Its authenticated API supports recent-IOC queries, searches for specific IOCs, malware-family queries, and submission of vetted IOCs. Community access is free for eligible users under fair-use limits; commercial use may require a paid subscription.

notes: The documented API has no operation for filtering or looking up IOCs by IOC type, making that description claim unsupported. Auth-Key is required. Official pages confirm qualitative query-volume limits and temporary restrictions, but they do not document HTTP 429 specifically. No official CORS policy was found.
